title: 100% Al coding game. Wanna give it a shot?
author: XenonDev1

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body: Thanks! Glad you liked it. The game graphics/assets were actually generated using Ludo.ai. I tried to keep the style simple and clean for the gameplay. If you have any suggestions to improve the graphics, I’d love to hear them. 😊

comments.author: Opening_Apricot_5419
comments.body: Interesting, I came in fifth place!

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body: Nice! Fifth place is pretty good. Try again and see if you can climb even higher on the leaderboard. Good luck! 😄

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: I liked it! Thought the swing was a bit strong/harsh for the animation but that's only if you were looking for feedback other than that congrats!

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! I appreciate it. I’ll definitely look into reducing the swing a bit in the next update to make the animation smoother. Glad you liked the game overall! 😊

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body:
No problem at all! and id say just reduce the overall speed of he swing very slightly and work on smoothing out the animation and potentially adding the most attention and polish there as its the main mechanic, and overall the rest of the game seems to be good where its at! 

Could play with adding birds that fly across the screen that you have to try not to smoosh either just to add a bit if a spin or I think making the tower react to how you're holding your phone meaning tilting helps keep it up. That would be really cool. I think!

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the detailed feedback, I really appreciate it! Reducing the swing speed and smoothing the animation is something I’m definitely going to work on since it’s the main mechanic.
I also like your ideas about birds flying across the screen and using phone tilt to keep the tower balanced — that could make the gameplay more interesting. I’ll experiment with these in future updates. Thanks again for the suggestions! 😊

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Np at all again! Happy to help just trying to be a helpful a supportive member of the sub 😄

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body: Glad you like it! 😄 Graphics are kept simple and clean intentionally — wanted the focus to stay on the gameplay. Already started fixing up some issues players pointed out, so updates are coming soon! Any specific improvements you'd like to see in the graphics? 👀

comments.author: XenonDev1
comments.body: Update: Swing speed fixed + new features in progress. Drop your ideas!

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: could use some sound equalizing. i like it though really cool

replies.author: XenonDev1
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Yeah, sound balancing is something I’m still tweaking. Glad you liked the game though — I’ll try to improve the audio in the next update.
